messages.author: 38c56d0e82a34280
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Adjust for covariates uisng Methylkit
parts:
Hi Saurabh-

We'll pushing out a version with that capability shortly- I can supply you with some custom code if you have something that's time sensitive. I wouldn't recommend analyzing two tissue types together unless you're specifically looking for sites that help differentiate between them. Also keep in mind that the more covariates you want to control for, the larger your sample size needs to be to get significant results. 

Dhruva
